source: BYOP workbook 'BUILD YOUR OWN PROGRAM - BLAZE CAMP MODEL', tabs 'PUSHPULLLEGS - 3 or 6 DAYS A WK', 'BOOTCAMP - OPTION 1', 'BOOTCAMP - OPTION 2' (read-only from raw/BYOP.xlsx). Companion: prog_byop_ppl_bootcamp.md

muscle_credit_map.convention: 1.0 per working set to each prime mover, 0.5 to clear synergists (analyst convention, INFERRED). Prime movers = muscles named by the coach's PURPOSE label and the library row-6 PURPOSE cell.
muscle_credit_map.FOCUS: not credited (client picks the muscle from the AZ list)

core_slot_note: Every 'Core' slot is wired to 'MASTER EXERCISE LIBRARY'!O7:O283, whose dropdown spans both the CORE THORAX and the CORE PELVIS blocks, so it is counted under CORE_OTHER (CT or CP is the client's choice). CT_CORE_THORAX and CP_CORE_PELVIS are therefore 0.
cardio_slot_note: Cardio slots counted as COND_AEROBIC. BOOTCAMP - OPTION 2 rows 7/12/22/27 (end of 1A/2A/1B/2B) use the full B7:B335 range, which also offers 'DISTANCE' (200m-1000m) and 'CALORIES' (10-50 cals) items that would be COND_SPRINT_BUYOUT; the client decides.

programs.goal: Hypertrophy / physique ('aesthetics') body-part split. No athletic, core, calf or cardio slots. Title says 6 days; the tab name offers 3 or 6.

days_per_week.note: A1 says 'PUSH/PULL/LEGS - 6 DAYS A WK'; the tab name says '3 or 6 DAYS A WK'. The 3-day version is inferred to be one Push/Pull/Legs cycle per week (Mon-Wed rows only). Sunday 'OFF'.

programs.progression_summary: None written. Only 'WEEK 1' exists (Mon-Sun); every SETS/REPS cell is 'CHOOSE 👇'. Mon-Wed are copied exactly to Thu-Sat, so week-1 frequency = 2x per pattern (6-day) or 1x (3-day). The level-to-level pattern comes from the coach's MASTER_MODEL 'EXAMPLE PUSHPULLLEGS SPLIT' (cross-reference, OBSERVED there): working sets per P/P/L cycle 47 (NOVICE) -> 58 (NEWBY, +23%) -> 66 (INTERMEDIATE, +14%). Compound reps go 15 -> 10 -> 8 as sets go 3 -> 3-4 -> 4-5, while curls, tricep extensions, leg extensions and leg curls stay at 20 reps at every level. Week-to-week ramps (3/5/7 %) are the coach's stated rule, not written in this tab.
notes: 7 slots in every session; Thu-Sat repeat Mon-Wed verbatim.
Focus 1 only on legs days (2 per week in the 6-day version).

programs.progression_summary: None written. Only 'WEEK 1'; every SETS/REPS/EFFORT/HOW IT FELT? cell is 'CHOOSE 👇'. Empty merged week cells A52:A58 and A59:A65 below Sunday suggest more blocks were planned. The nearest worked example is MASTER_MODEL 'EXAMPLE FAT BURNBODY TONING PRO' (cross-reference). It uses the same weekly skeleton (4 lifting days plus Wed/Sat '30-40 mi slow/steady CARDIO') and climbs 60 -> 60 -> 64 -> 70 sets per week over 4 weeks (+0 %, +6.7 %, +9.4 %, +16.7 % in total). Compound reps fall (15 -> 8) while isolation reps rise (15 -> 20 -> 40). The EFFORT (1-10, '8 - That was perfect') and HOW IT FELT? columns are the autoregulation inputs for those ramps.
notes: Same 14 resistance slots as AESTHETICS, re-paired so each day has 1 knee + 1 hip pattern and 1 push + 1 pull.
E30 holds the only filled exercise in the three tabs: 'Leg extensions' (invalid spelling vs list item 'Leg Extensions').
